DIAGNOSIS READY: Lymphoma

The combination of significant weight loss (18.1 kg), chronic fatigue, normal blood work (which rules out acute infection or severe organ failure), and the absence of fever or night sweats at this stage, combined with his age, raises high suspicion for an indolent lymphoma. While we have not yet confirmed lymphadenopathy, the clinical picture is highly suggestive. I recommend an urgent CT scan of the neck, chest, abdomen, and pelvis to look for lymph node masses.
